title: BattleBorg.ai - Game where AI generates 3D fighters from text descriptions AND narrates their battles with wild commentary
author: kaayotee
selftext:
Hey Folks,
I am a solo dev working on [https://battleborg.ai](https://battleborg.ai)   
  
You basically design these hypothetical fighters with text description 100 character or less- think ancient sorcerers, elemental guardians, shadow assassins, whatever your imagination comes up with. 

The game generates actual 3D models (cloud hosted stability model). Then you pit them against other players' creations in battles that are simulated by AI, complete with live commentary.  


Highlights:

* The AI  writes unique battle stories for each fight based on characters description
* Your warrior's description directly affects how it looks in 3D
* ELO ranking system with 8 tiers from "Trainee" to "Legendary"
* Daily rewards for top performers (because who doesn't like free stuff). Leaderboard

Appreciate if you try it out.

Thanks for reading.

comments.author: midnight__notes
comments.body: This looks sweet, I'll give it a try. Is there a cap on a character's strength (if someone describes a warrior as "invincible" will they end up dominating?) and what was your workflow to get to this stage?

replies.author: kaayotee
replies.body: There is no cap. The judge AI will decide based on your creativeness of power and description. I have tested with invisible and similar power , thor and thanos combinations as well. AI does a good job of  balancing creativity.

comments.author: Weird_Bad7577
comments.body: Would be nice if we could add some sort of reinforcement learning algorithms for these models and we could actually see them fight.. would have been cool
